items: (used with verbs) over, over again (describing an action of moving by overcoming one or more obstacles) — пере- + лете́ть (“to fly”) → перелете́ть (“to fly (by avoiding unpleasant factors such as bad weathers, falling objects, etc.; as one of its meanings)”)
(used with verbs) across, trans- (describing an action of moving to a different place) — пере- + -йти́ (“to go”) → перейти́ (“to cross”)
(used with verbs) too much (describing an action of resulting something excessive) — пере- + стара́ться (“to try hard”) → перестара́ться (“to overdo, try too hard”)

(used with verbs) extremely (describing an action of doing something much more extreme than an average action) — пере- + крича́ть (“to shout”) → перекрича́ть (“to shout down (i.e. shouting much louder than someone)”)
(used with verbs) re- (describing a repeating action) — пере- + смотре́ть (“to look, see”) → пересмотре́ть (“to review (i.e. seeing something again); to rewatch”)

items: (used with verbs) through, past (describing an action of passing through a space or an object) — про- + -йти́ (“to go”) → пройти́ (“to go through, to pass by”); про- + ступа́ть (“to tread, step”) → проступа́ть (“to exude, ooze (in a metaphorical sense)”)
(used with verbs) describing an action of passing by an entity and moving further from an entity — про- + пусти́ть (“to let”) → пропусти́ть (“to let pass through”)
(used with verbs) describing an action that entails completeness, exhaustiveness, or accuracy — про- + штуди́ровать (“to study (in a form of researching)”) → проштуди́ровать (“to study thoroughly”)

(used with verbs) describing an action that lasts for a certain period of time — про- + ждать (“to wait”) → прожда́ть (“to wait (for a while, for some time)”); про- + рабо́тать (“to work”) → прорабо́тать (“to work (for a while, for some time)”); про- + сиде́ть (“to sit”) → просиде́ть (“to sit (for a while, for some time)”)

(used with verbs) describing an action that describes losses, expenses, wasting, or forgetting — про- + срок (“period, term”) + -ить → просро́чить (“to expire (time-wise, as time for doing something is lost)”); про- + пасть (“to fall”) → пропа́сть (“to get lost”)
